title: hive-spec define: request body
description: Writes a specification revision: revision 1 of a new specification, or the next revision of an existing one, whole. For every item currently bound to any revision of this specification, a revision whose criteria differ from the criteria of the revision that item is bound to invalidates that item's acceptance and clears the criteria from the item; the item's definition returns to defining. An item that resolves its effective specification through that item, a Hunt through its Prey and a Prey through its Target, and has no binding of its own, returns to defining with a definition hold when it is dispatchable and has not landed, and nothing else of it changes. See spec/pool.md, Specifications.

specification_id.description: Absent creates a new specification; present revises it, with the envelope's expected_revisions naming its revision.

task_ids.description: Items this specification is being defined for. An item with no accepted binding to this specification moves to definition defining; an item whose accepted binding survives this revision, because its criteria are unchanged against the revision it is bound to, keeps definition accepted and its binding.
